name: repo-progress
description: See where every repository you work on stands in one table: worktrees, open issues and pull requests, uncommitted files, and which ones have stalled, without changing anything

interface.longDescription: Shows every repository you have committed to in one table, read-only. For each local clone it counts linked worktrees, open GitHub issues and pull requests, and uncommitted files, shows the time since the last commit, and sorts by an idle score, days since the last commit times open issues, so stalled repositories come first. For one repository it lists the branches in progress with their pull requests, the branches whose issue is closed and the worktrees whose folder is gone, and the open issues nobody has started. When GitHub cannot be reached it shows the counts as unknown instead of 0. It uses Python, git, and the GitHub CLI, and never changes a repository, a branch, or an issue.
defaultPrompt: Show where each of my repositories stands
